payload.text: For WP-05, from dc's launch of menuz for hv on hv's word (16 Oct 19:2xZ, after the fold): hv's menuz now exists for real: ~/.config/menuz holds the example (dc ran menuz init; validate ok) and cc's Debug Menuz.app from ~/.local/state/menuz/build runs as pid 96193 with 'NSStatusItem Preferred Position Item-0' = 700 written by dc into com.matthewsinclair.utilz.menuz's defaults (hv wants the item between Hammerspoon and Intent, whose slot is 672); ~/.config/menuz/bin/arngz is dc's link to the checkout's bin/arngz, because hv's login shell has no arngz (hv's utilz is the brew keg at 2.12.1 while the tap lacks 2.13.0, and ~/.local/bin holds only utilz), so hv's first three runs (Discover twice, Hammerspoon doctor) logged 'command not found: arngz', exit 127, with menuz itself behaving right. Findings for cc's WP-05 objective and the design, hv's call on each: (1) a fresh install lands leftmost and invisible on a full menu bar behind macOS 27's overflow: vc recommends no seeded position but a command-drag line in the help and a first-run log line; (2) no app icon, so the Menu Bar settings list shows a blank: vc recommends one AppIcon rendered at build from the SF Symbol unless hv wants a drawn one; (3) the default 'terminal' glyph is hard to pick out in the overflow (hv had to count icons): a more distinctive default, or the help's advice to set icon:, hv's call; (4) OPEN, dc is asking hv: did any failure notice post for the three exit-127 runs (notify defaults to failure, posted by the wrapper through osascript, which macOS attributes to Script Editor and may need allowing under System Settings > Notifications)? If hv saw none, the notice route is a WP-04 defect to fix in WP-05 (measure first: osascript -e 'display notification "x" with title "menuz"' from a terminal on hv's machine), and cc's options include a notice posted by the app while it runs with the wrapper's osascript only as the fallback after a quit.
